text:
Rowan: alert — nightly billing run run_2026_04_03_02 produced a batch of malformed invoices. multiple customers missing prorated seat lines, and 8 customers got duplicate PDFs. opening thread to coordinate.
Leila: which samples/accounts?
Rowan: INV-PEAK-0123 (acct-peaklabs), INV-AXI-0048 (acct-axion), INV-MER-210 (acct-mercuria). run id run_2026_04_03_02.
Marco: I pulled the pipeline logs. invoice-aggregation stage aborted on a couple of timeouts, then the retry path requeued render jobs without the idempotency_key. that leads to partial invoice objects and second PDF writes. snippet:
```
2026-04-03T06:41:12Z ERROR invoice_agg: AggregationTimeout invoice=INV-PEAK-0123
2026-04-03T06:41:13Z WARN queue: requeued_job id=61123 idempotency_key=null
2026-04-03T06:41:16Z INFO pdf_store: wrote tmp/inv_INV-PEAK-0123_partial.pdf
```
Tara: support already has a ticket from PeakLabs at 06:50 UTC. pausing collections for the flagged accounts.
Leila: finance exposure estimate?
Rowan: rough scan ~ $1,300 (proration + onboarding credits). will confirm once we enumerate.
Marco: hotfix plan: 1) enforce idempotency_key propagation across aggregation+render stages 2) make pdf writes atomic (tmp + rename) 3) add dedupe guard in pdf-store 4) run backfill to regenerate affected invoices. estimate ~90 minutes to push and run backfill.
Leila: please pause nightly runner until fix is deployed.
Marco: paused nightly job on batch07 with `systemctl stop invoice-nightly`. starting staging deploy for branch billing/fix-agg-idempotency.
ops-bot: Deploy started for billing/fix-agg-idempotency -> staging
Tara: CS: hold outbound messages until regen finishes. offer $25 courtesy credit to affected customers.
Marco: dry-run backfill: `python tools/invoice_backfill.py --run run_2026_04_03_02 --dry-run` -> found 38 invoices missing prorated lines, 8 duplicate PDFs.
Rowan: ok hold credits until we verify final counts.
ops-bot: Deploy to production succeeded for billing/fix-agg-idempotency @ 2026-04-03T08:02:31Z
Marco: prod backfill finished: regenerated 38 invoices, deduped 8 duplicates, uploaded corrected PDFs to invoice-store, queued resend emails. summary:
```
backfill_summary: regenerated=38, deduped=8, skipped=0, duration=36m
```
Leila: finance preparing credit memos for $1,320 total. will attach approval and journals after CS confirms sends.
Tara: CS will send corrected invoices this afternoon with credit applied. template in #support. owners: Marco (fix + backfill), Tara (customer comms), Leila (finance credits). please add postmortem once incident closed. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
